policy: Use registries for discovery; verify facts, licenses, prices and availability at primary sources.

sources.name: Models.dev
sources.use: Broad model/provider discovery; verify important facts against official sources.
sources.limitations: Large catalogue; not every record is a primary-source assertion.

sources.name: Hugging Face Hub
sources.use: Discover model repositories, model cards and dataset records.
sources.refresh: Live API; respect pagination and rate limits
sources.limitations: Repository metadata does not establish license compatibility or model quality.

sources.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
sources.limitations: Partner listing does not guarantee every model, region or feature is available.

sources.name: OpenRouter
sources.use: Discover models available through its gateway and provider mappings.
sources.limitations: Catalogue is limited to OpenRouter's integrations; not a global inventory.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis
sources.limitations: Coverage, methodology and access vary; never treat as universal truth.

sources.name: LMArena
sources.limitations: Rankings are task- and sample-dependent; not a full capability evaluation.

sources.name: Vercel AI Gateway
sources.limitations: Reflects Vercel's supported catalogue, not every provider worldwide.

sources.name: GitHub Models
sources.use: Discover models available within GitHub's model tooling.
sources.limitations: Access and quotas depend on GitHub plan, preview terms and availability.

sources.name: Amazon Bedrock model catalogue
sources.use: Verify Bedrock model availability and region support.
sources.limitations: Requires region-specific verification; marketplace listings may differ.

sources.name: Microsoft Foundry model catalogue
sources.use: Discover and verify models available through Azure.
sources.limitations: Availability varies by region, subscription and deployment type.

sources.name: Google Cloud Model Garden
sources.use: Discover models and deployment options on Google Cloud.
sources.limitations: Access and deployment options depend on region and account.

sources.name: NVIDIA NGC / AI models
sources.use: Discover deployable model artifacts and inference containers.
sources.limitations: Container availability, hardware and license terms differ per artifact.
